external_entities.name: customer company
external_entities.description: A customer organization using the invoicing service as a tenant.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant
external_entities.notes: Each customer company is one tenant.

external_entities.name: customer user
external_entities.description: A person at a customer company who uses the billing app.
external_entities.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
external_entities.notes: Users are either admins or viewers.

external_entities.name: payer
external_entities.description: The person receiving an invoice email and viewing the payment page.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.
external_entities.notes: The payment page asks the payer to sign in to nothing.

external_entities.name: support agent
external_entities.description: A support employee who uses the admin console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.
external_entities.notes: Each agent signs in with their own account and a one-time code.

processes.name: billing app
processes.description: The shared invoicing application used by customer users and support agents.
processes.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app
processes.notes: Nobody wrote down whether it checks invoice company ownership or rechecks the user's role when a request arrives. The app connects with one database account for all companies.

processes.name: PDF renderer
processes.description: A worker that consumes render jobs, reads invoices, and writes PDFs.
processes.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
processes.notes: It trusts the company ID the job carries.

processes.name: admin console
processes.description: A console used by support agents to open sessions in the billing app as customer users.
processes.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
processes.notes: The admin console is reachable only from the support office network.

data_stores.name: tenant database
data_stores.description: A shared PostgreSQL database containing all companies' invoices, customers, and payout bank details.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database, the tenant database.
data_stores.notes: Every table has a company ID column. The database has no row-level security. Nobody recorded how the database is protected at rest.

data_stores.name: render queue
data_stores.description: A queue containing PDF render jobs with a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app puts a render job on the render queue.
data_stores.notes: Nobody recorded how the billing app and the renderer reach the queue.

data_stores.name: PDF bucket
data_stores.description: A shared bucket containing rendered invoice PDFs under company and invoice identifiers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the PDF renderer ... writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number.
data_stores.notes: The billing app fetches PDFs with one service credential for all companies. Nobody recorded how the bucket is protected at rest.

data_flows.name: use billing app
data_flows.description: A customer user uses the billing app, including opening and editing invoices.
data_flows.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
data_flows.notes: The invoice edit form posts the whole invoice back, and the billing app saves every field it receives.
data_flows.authentication: email address and password; session cookie; no second factor
data_flows.data_description: Invoices and customer and payout bank details

data_flows.name: request PDF
data_flows.description: A customer user asks the billing app for a PDF of an invoice.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Any user can ask for a PDF of any invoice, as often as they like.
data_flows.data_description: A request for an invoice PDF

data_flows.name: send invoice email
data_flows.description: The billing app sends the payer an invoice email containing a link ending in the invoice number.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice link containing the invoice number

data_flows.name: view payment page
data_flows.description: The payer opens the invoice payment page.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The payment page shows the invoice, the company's name and its bank details
data_flows.notes: The payer is not asked to sign in.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice, company name, and bank details

data_flows.name: access tenant data
data_flows.description: The billing app queries and updates the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app adds the company filter to each query itself
data_flows.notes: The app uses one database account for all companies.
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customers, payout bank details, and recorded user actions

data_flows.name: enqueue render job
data_flows.description: The billing app puts a render job on the render queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app puts a render job on the render queue.
data_flows.notes: The job carries a company ID and an invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: Company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: take render job
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer takes render jobs from the queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
data_flows.data_description: Company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: read invoice
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer reads an invoice from the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: reads the invoice from the tenant database
data_flows.data_description: Invoice data

data_flows.name: write PDF
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer writes a rendered PDF to the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number.
data_flows.notes: The renderer trusts the company ID the job carries.
data_flows.data_description: Rendered invoice PDF, company ID, and invoice number

data_flows.name: fetch PDF
data_flows.description: The billing app fetches PDFs from the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app fetches PDFs from the bucket with one service credential for all companies.
data_flows.notes: One service credential is used for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one service credential for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Rendered invoice PDFs

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A support agent signs in to the admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: each agent signs in to it with their own account and a one-time code.
data_flows.data_description: Support agent account credentials and one-time code

data_flows.name: open user session
data_flows.description: The admin console opens a billing-app session as a customer user.
data_flows.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
data_flows.notes: Everything the agent then does is recorded against the customer user, and not against the agent.
data_flows.data_description: Customer-user session

trust_boundaries.name: customer company
trust_boundaries.description: A customer-company tenant boundary; each customer company is a separate tenant.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

trust_boundaries.name: cloud platform
trust_boundaries.description: The organization's cloud platform containing the shared billing app, tenant database, and PDF bucket.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app, one database and one PDF bucket in our cloud platform.

trust_boundaries.name: support office network
trust_boundaries.description: The network from which support agents work and the admin console is reachable.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

assumptions.assumption: The tenant database contains confidential data because it stores invoices, customer information, and payout bank details.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the database contains every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details.

assumptions.assumption: The PDF bucket contains confidential data because it stores rendered invoice PDFs.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the PDF renderer writes invoice PDFs to the bucket; the payment page includes invoice and bank-detail data.
